name: Remove temperature, top_p and top_k from Claude requests
gain: On API version 2026-10-21 a request that sends any of the three returns a 400, even at the default. The first SDK majors on that version include Python 2.0.0 and TypeScript 1.0.0.
how: Stop sending the three parameters before upgrading the SDK major. A request that relies on a non-default value can stay on 2023-06-01 for now.
replaces: temperature, top_p or top_k on a Messages or Message Batches request.
trade_offs: On a model that accepts other values, such as Sonnet 4.6, a request that lowered temperature loses that effect, and no other setting replaces it.
Nothing breaks until the SDK major or the version header changes, unless the model is Claude 4.7 or later and the value is non-default.
usage_signal: Usage API: calls on the affected model or parameter

gain_model.formula: no money figure: the call stops working or a capability is missing

verify_rule: The old id or parameter is gone and calls succeed over 7 days

change_recipe.how: Stop sending the three parameters before upgrading the SDK major. A request that relies on a non-default value can stay on 2023-06-01 for now.
change_recipe.left_off: Nothing else changes; the new path sits behind a setting until a person turns it on
